messages:
Nora: Quick heads up from the onboarding sweep. When we run speculative decoding with q8 on the 13B candidate, we see a marginal but consistent drop in intent F1 for the travel intent cluster on multi-turn prompts. This was most visible at early_exit_p=0.90.
Devon: do we have raw numbers?
Nora: short table from a 300-prompt pass (speculative=true, seeds=5):
- f32 baseline intent F1: 0.87
- q8 speculative intent F1: 0.83
- q8 no-speculative intent F1: 0.86
So speculative seems to be the main knob.
Sam: that suggests speculative induced prefix mismatch. Could be kv-cache timing or mismatch between provisional logits and final pass.
Nora: noted. I extracted token-level mismatch counts and it correlates with F1 drop.
Devon: ops-bot, can we run a holdout for user-visible traffic simulation to estimate p50/p95 latency tradeoffs if we disable speculative?
ops-bot: scheduling 4xA100s for 6h at 1718289000. Tag: @Nora. :white_check_mark:
metrics-bot: quick metric run (n=300): early_exit_rate f32=12.1%, q8_spec=18.4%, q8_nospec=13.0%
Nora: interesting. early_exit rate jumps with speculative on q8 which explains shorter outputs.
Devon: mitigation ideas? conditional speculative only for high-confidence prefixes?
Sam: we can compute a prefix-stable score from token entropy; only speculative-prefill when entropy<preset. That may avoid noisy prefixes.
Nora: adding to TODO: prototype prefix-entropy gating, run ablation. Also include early_exit smoothing (moving average p over last 3 tokens) to avoid single-token blips.
Devon: capture user-impact: shorter responses might break downstream parsers expecting trailing punctuation. Add parser-failure rate to metrics.
Nora: will include. Plan: quick AB for gating vs disable speculative, upload artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/spec-gate/1718285555/
Sam: CC prod-security; if gating helps we can ship as default for q8.
Nora: thanks team. Uploading results shortly. :package:
